user.title: Inverter Charge Night – Entities
user.description: Step 1 of 4: Select the core entities and set your battery capacity.

data_description.name: Name for this integration instance
data_description.kostal_min_soc_entity: Number entity that controls the inverter minimum SOC
data_description.kostal_grid_charge_switch: Switch entity that enables/disables grid charging
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: Solcast or other entity providing tomorrow's PV forecast (kWh)
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Sensor showing current battery state of charge (%)

time_soc.title: Inverter Charge Night – Time & SOC
time_soc.description: Step 2 of 4: Configure the charging time window and SOC limits.

data_description.end_time: Time when night charging ends and settings are reset
data_description.user_min_soc: Calculated SOC will never go below this value
data_description.user_max_soc: Calculated SOC will never exceed this value
data_description.forecast_error_margin: Safety margin added to forecast before calculation
data_description.default_min_soc: Min SOC value restored when the charging window ends

power.title: Inverter Charge Night – Charge Power
power.description: Step 3 of 4: Configure charge power limits and optional power entities.

data_description.min_charge_power_w: Minimum charge power for auto-efficient mode
data_description.max_charge_power_w: Maximum charge power for auto-efficient mode
data_description.absolute_max_charge_power_w: Hard limit for total charge power (AC+DC combined). Leave empty if not needed.
data_description.absolute_max_charge_power_entity: Number entity to set the absolute max charge power
data_description.charge_power_entity: Number entity to control the max AC charge limit
data_description.grid_import_energy_entity: Cumulative energy sensor for total grid import (kWh). Use a 'Total' counter, not daily.
data_description.battery_charge_energy_entity: Cumulative energy sensor for battery charge from grid (kWh). Use a 'Total' counter, not daily.
data_description.home_consumption_energy_entity: Cumulative energy sensor for home consumption from grid (kWh). Use a 'Total' counter, not daily.

advanced.title: Inverter Charge Night – Advanced
advanced.description: Step 4 of 4: Fine-tune update intervals, active dates and optional features.

data_description.update_interval: How often the coordinator refreshes data
data_description.command_delay: Delay between min SOC and grid charge commands
data_description.active_start_date: Only run after this date. Leave empty to always run.
data_description.active_end_date: Only run before this date. Leave empty to always run.
data_description.backup_mode_entity: Entity indicating backup/island mode. If active, charging is paused.
data_description.auto_efficient_charge: Automatically search for the most efficient charge power between min and max
